review.verbatim_critique: [D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The note proves the advertised full-class bracket and a matched oracle-rate result only in the no-penalty region; throughout the strict rough-confounding regime it supplies an upper rate but no nuisance-scale converse, so it does not establish the complete minimax frontier suggested by the title. The prose accurately confines the unresolved claim to that regime and does not falsely call the differing endpoints sharp. The claim that the attaining test is explicitly computable is under-documented because the projectors, basis normalization, grid-rounding rules, and numerical constructions of C_B and C_0 are described generically rather than specified sufficiently for direct independent implementation. The missing rough-regime characterization, impractical worst-case arithmetic cost, and absence of computational evidence for the proposed calibration keep the projected paper below the matched-frontier calibration anchors. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.6 < 7.2, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
